TITLE: IND desks and locations | IND

IND desks and locations
The IND has different locations in the Netherlands. On this page you find where these locations are.
Application centres
Expat centres / IND Service Points
IND desks
Offices
Application Centres
At application centres, asylum seekers register to apply for asylum.
Show details
Hide details
1. Ter Apel application centre
Ter Apel application centre
Ter Apelervenen 3
9561 MC Ter Apel
Always bring a valid proof of identity with you.
Opening hours
Monday to Friday: 08.00 - 18.00.
Route description
Plan your route to the Ter Apel application centre
by car or by public transport. Check the address including the postcode before you leave.
Parking
The application centre has its own free parking spaces.
Show Ter Apel application centre on map
2. Schiphol application centre
​
Schiphol application centre (ACS)
Duizendbladweg 100
1171 VA Badhoevedorp
Always bring a valid proof of identity with you.
Opening hours
Monday to Friday: 09.00 - 17.00.
Route description
Plan your route to the Schiphol application centre
by car or by public transport. Check the address including the postcode before you leave.
Parking
Registered visitors of the application centre can park free of charge. Visitors who are not registered pay €2.50 per hour.
You can only pay with a debit card.
Show Schiphol application centre on map

4. Zevenaar application centre
​
Zevenaar application centre
Ringbaan Zuid 2a
6905 AB Zevenaar
Always bring a valid proof of identity with you.
Opening hours
Monday to Friday: 09.00 - 16.00.
You must make an appointment to visit the Zevenaar application centre.
Route description
Plan your route to the Zevenaar application centre
by car or by public transport. Check the address including the postcode before you leave.
Parking
Registered visitors can park in the parking lot of the IND. Are you not registered? You can park in the parking lot at zalencentrum Staring. Do you have difficulties walking? Please contact the IND.
Show Zevenaar application center on map
5. Budel application centre
​
Budel application centre
Randweg-Oost 32
6021 PB Budel
Always bring a valid proof of identity with you.
Opening hours
Monday to Friday: 09.00 - 16.00
Route description
Plan your route to Budel application centre
by car or by public transport. Check the address including the postcode before you leave.
Parking
Have you been registered by an IND staff member? Then you can park in the car park of the application centre. Otherwise you can use the paid parking facilities in the area.
Show Budel application centre on map
Expat Centres / IND Service Points
Expat centres help highly skilled migrants on their arrival and with their residency in the Netherlands. For example, at an expat centre you can get a residence endorsement sticker, have your biometric data taken and collect your residence document. You must make an appointment to do this.
Each expat center can decide for itself whether and how much you have to pay (extra) for the service.
Do you not want to pay for these services? Then choose an IND desk  or IND Service Point on your residence permit application form to collect your residence permit. The IND offers these services free of charge.

9. Expat Centre Maastricht Region (ECMR) / IND Service Point Maastricht
Expat Centre Maastricht Region (ECMR) / IND Service Point Maastricht
Mosae Forum 10
6211 DW Maastricht
IND Service Point
You can visit the IND Service Point by appointment only.
To make an appointment, go to
Expat Centre Maastricht Region (ECMR) / IND Service Point Maastricht
.

The IND Service Point provides the following services and products:
Taking biometrics
Issue of residence document
Issue of residence endorsement sticker or return visa

IND desks
At the desks you can submit an application, get a residence endorsement sticker, collect your residence document or have biometric data taken, for example. Before you visit the desks, you first need to make an appointment
online
. All IND desks are easily accessible by individuals in wheelchairs.
